notes.title: The mystery awaits you
notes.notes:
Lost in the thick fog, an ancient mansion hides a terrifying secret. Deadly traps, nightmarish creatures and heartbreaking puzzles await you inside. Every creak, every rustle is a reminder of your fragile life. Stay calm, conserve resources and unravel the creepy story before the darkness consumes you forever. Can you survive this nightmare?
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343720/Spooky_Shelter/]The mystery awaits you[/url]
